title: G06: close the missing pre-counter issuance test case
public_pr_body:
Fills the explicit before-counter issue attempt absent from #373 without duplicating its actual setter/double-run/concurrency/undo-after-use tests. Three committed-code tests passed: blank and typed number attempts refuse with dln_numbering_not_set before the allocator sentinel is reached; both companies' snapshots stay unchanged; the other company remains held after only fixture JNR's hold is lifted.

Loads exact hold/guard slices from public release 147 at pinned 31f965e7 with git show; no candidate checkout or #359 edits. Creates its own random, nonce-labelled network-isolated PostgreSQL container; verifies container/image/label/ports/database before SQL; accepts no DB URL. Synthetic records only. Code tested: 412fd82; original output/SQL hash/commit/environment/time/exit records retained in tests/reviews/g06-before-counter/evidence. Scoped lint passed.

G06: review done, two existing conditional SQL-role findings from #373 remain open; no new finding in these three narrow checks. Full final-candidate/browser/RLS/audit/allocator acceptance remains unverified. No source fix or security expectation change.

Separate branch from main 68f89ca. Tests/docs only. No merge, production SQL, real data, Ready label, or message to John.
